days.title: Into Lac village
days.morning: Drive ~3.5 h from Hanoi, stopping at Thung Khe pass for valley views.
days.afternoon: Check into a stilt house in Lac village, walk the paddies and watch brocade weaving.
days.evening: Bamboo rice, grilled stream fish and xoe dancing by the fire.

days.title: Cycle to Pom Coong
days.morning: Cycle through the rice fields to Pom Coong village.
days.afternoon: Climb the steps to Chieu cave above the Mai Chau fields.
days.evening: Tube wine and Thai folk songs.

days.title: Van and Nhot villages
days.morning: Cycle to the quieter Van and Nhot villages.
days.afternoon: Swim in a stream and lunch with a Thai family.

days.title: Hang Kia trek
days.morning: Drive up to the H'Mong villages of Hang Kia – Pa Co.
days.afternoon: Trek the plum hills and watch clouds roll over Pa Co.
days.evening: Back to Lac village for the night.

days.title: Hoa Binh lake – back to Hanoi
days.morning: A boat on Hoa Binh lake and a visit to Thac Bo temple.
days.afternoon: Lake-fish lunch, then back to Hanoi.
